plan.title: SRC-AWD-013 Split award across two vendors

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A and Vendor B bids.
Enable quantity splitting across vendors as required by the case.
Enable eRFX project behavior required by the setup.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate 6 units of the line to Vendor B.
Allocate the remaining 4 units to Vendor A.
Verify both vendors are selected and the split total is 6 × 90 + 4 × 100 = 940.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Complete mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the proposal as required by the case.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Use the available downstream PO flow to create and read back purchase orders for the awarded vendors.
Verify two awarded PO line records exist, corresponding to the two awarded vendors.
